name: registry-run-key-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): writes one autorun value into a chosen registry location -- a Run/RunOnce key, a policy Run key, a WOW6432Node view, or a per-user hive. Writes the payload file when PAYLOAD_PATH/PAYLOAD_BODY are supplied. Vars: KEY (required, subkey under the hive); VALUE_NAME (required); VALUE_DATA (required); HIVE (optional, HKLM default or HKCU); USERNAME (optional, HKCU only -- loads that local user's NTUSER.DAT if the hive is not currently loaded); PAYLOAD_PATH / PAYLOAD_BODY (optional). Idempotent. NOTE: HKCU without USERNAME targets the SSH principal's own hive. Pairs with registry_value (HKLM) or powershell_json (HKU/SID) checks expecting the value absent.
